items.title: Johns Hopkins Health Plans taps interim CEO as it searches for successor
items.summary: Daniel Chojnowski, JHHP’s current CFO, will provide stability so that the Baltimore-area insurer can recruit full-time for its next chief executive, the company said.

items.title: Humana (HUM) Names New Medical Chief On AI Push As Valuation Debate Builds
items.summary: Humana (HUM) has drawn fresh attention after announcing that Shantanu Nundy, M.D., will become Chief Medical Officer on August 31, 2026, in a move that foregrounds technology, AI and clinical leadership. Humana’s appointment of a technology focused Chief Medical Officer comes as the stock trades at US$383.23. items.title: UNH Stock Gets Cheaper Only If The Margins Come Back
items.summary: Consensus knocks a quarter off the health insurer's earnings multiple over two years, part of it measurement, and almost none of it from selling more coverage.

items.title: Humana Is Cutting Medicare Advantage Plans for 2027. The Non-Renewal Letters Arrive in Early October.
items.summary: A non-renewal notice from Humana can feel like bad news, but buried inside federal Medicare rules is a protection that most long-time Advantage members have no idea they still qualify for.

items.title: Is CVS Stock Set for a Rebound?
items.summary: Its market-shock drawdowns have been ordinary in depth, and some of its longest waits back to the old high came after falls the index barely noticed.

items.title: CVRx Secures Devoted Health Coverage for Barostim Therapy

items.title: Can a $68 Billion Payout Save UNH Stock?
